scoring_justification: Agent runs a classical MD simulation and reports hydrogen bond statistics; the hidden checker compares the reported numeric values to the paper's gold within tolerances. Recomputing from raw MD trajectories is infeasible in the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference hydrogen bond statistics from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper section 3.2: lepidocrocite (010) μ-OH site density 8.4 sites nm^{-2}; (001) median donor-H-acceptor angle 8°, donor fraction 12%; goethite (110) -OH···-OH angle ca. 25°, donor fraction about every second -OH (0.5); μ₃,ᵣ-OH···HO- angle 11-12°, donor fraction virtually all (0.95).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from the paper's reported hydrogen-bond statistics.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers given in the paper for the computed properties.

schema.description: Each row contains one hydrogen-bond statistic. See step description for the required properties.

outputs.description: Numerical hydrogen-bond statistics for lepidocrocite (010), (001) and goethite (110) planes.

schema.description: A qualitative statement that the hydrogen-bond network on goethite (021) is extensive and prevents discrete band assignment.

outputs.description: Qualitative summary of hydrogen bonding on the goethite (021) plane.

output_contract.notes: The quantitative CSV is checked against hidden paper gold with tolerances; the text file is checked for existence and presence of the expected statement.
